decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ INTRODUCE already states that prize wins appear on the Winners page and are claimable with one click.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records the Winners page as the announcement channel; one-click claiming belongs to the separate claim-flow Requirement.
The claim action and location do not change Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, eligibility, funding, or ticket-reset rules.
The claim action and location do not change Small Block prize amounts, draw triggers, eligibility, funding, or ticket-reset rules.
Changing where and how winners claim prizes does not alter the VRF selection method or its verification properties.
The prize claim flow does not alter ticket allocation for mints completed without a referral code.
The claim action and location do not alter referral-triggered ticket issuance, recipients, quantities, or ticket cycles.
One-click claiming on the Winners page does not change the Small Block or Big Block ticket counters or reset semantics.
The claim-flow change does not alter the requirement to expose prize-pool values through unauthenticated public APIs.
The source distinguishes automatically transferred commissions from one-click prize claims, leaving commission payout behavior unchanged.
The prize claim action and location do not change referral-code identity, sharing, display, permanence, or resale behavior.
The claim-flow change does not modify the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or prize-pool revenue destinations.
